meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: Find out what personal data WeUnite collects, why, and under what legal basis it's processed.

s1.title: 1. Data controller
s1.p1: The controller of your personal data is WeUnite, based at ul. Gdyńska G/9, 80-340 Gdańsk, Poland.
s1.p2: Contact the Controller at <email>info@weunite.pl</email> or by phone: +48 537 732 320.

s2.title: 2. What data we collect, and from where
s2.intro: We only collect data that you provide to us yourself:
items: Contact form (Lead): full name, email address, type of business, service interest.
Call booking system: full name, email address, chosen meeting time.
Email correspondence: information contained in the message itself.
s2.p1: We do not collect sensitive data (Article 9 GDPR) or data relating to children under 16. The Site is not directed at minors.

s3.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases for processing
s3.intro: We process your data for the following purposes:

a.title: a) Handling your inquiry and delivering the free consultation
a.body: Legal basis: Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (necessary for the performance of a contract or to take steps prior to entering into one) and Article 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent given by submitting the form).

b.title: b) The automatic email sequence (Day 0 / Day 2 / Day 4)
b.body: Legal basis: Article 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent) — you can opt out at any time by clicking the "unsubscribe" link in any email.

c.title: c) Managing your call booking and reminders (48h / 24h / 1h)
c.body: Legal basis: Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of a contract / steps prior to entering into one).

d.title: d) Marketing WeUnite's own services
d.body: Legal basis: Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (the Controller's legitimate interest) — only in relation to people who have previously expressed interest in our offer.

e.title: e) Analytics and improving the Site
e.body: Legal basis: Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest) — using analytics tools (PostHog) we collect anonymous/pseudonymized data about how the Site is used.

s4.title: 4. How long we keep your data
items: Data from the contact form and booking system: until your inquiry has been handled, and then for 3 years from the last contact, or until you file a valid objection.
Data used for marketing purposes: until consent is withdrawn or an objection is raised.
Data necessary to establish, pursue, or defend legal claims: for the statutory limitation period for claims (generally 3 years for claims related to business activity).
System logs and analytics data: up to 13 months.

s5.title: 5. Recipients of data (sub-processors)
s5.intro: Your data may only be shared with trusted parties that process data on our behalf, under data processing agreements:
items: Supabase Inc. (USA) — database and storage of lead records and booking slots. Data is stored in the EU region (Frankfurt). Transfer takes place under Standard Contractual Clauses (Article 46 GDPR).
Resend Inc. (USA) — sending emails (confirmations, sequences, reminders). Transfer takes place under Standard Contractual Clauses.
Vercel Inc. (USA) — application hosting. Data is stored in the EU region. Transfer under Standard Contractual Clauses.
PostHog Inc. (USA/EU) — analytics tool. Data may be stored in the EU region. Transfer under Standard Contractual Clauses.
s5.p1: We do not sell your personal data to third parties or share it with external parties for advertising purposes.

s6.title: 6. Your rights
s6.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
items: Right of access (Article 15 GDPR) — you can request a copy of your data.
Right to rectification (Article 16 GDPR) — you can request that inaccurate data be corrected or incomplete data be completed.
Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten", Article 17 GDPR) — you can request that your data be deleted once it is no longer needed for the purposes it was collected for.
Right to restriction of processing (Article 18 GDPR) — you can request that processing be restricted in certain cases.
Right to data portability (Article 20 GDPR) — available for data processed on the basis of consent or a contract.
Right to object (Article 21 GDPR) — you can object to processing based on legitimate interest, including direct marketing.
Right to withdraw consent — at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal.
s6.p1: To exercise the rights above, contact us at <email>info@weunite.pl</email>. We will respond within 30 days of receiving your request.
s6.p2: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority — the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO), ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw, Poland, <uodoLink>uodo.gov.pl</uodoLink>.

s7.title: 7. Data security
s7.intro: We apply appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or destruction, including:
items: encrypted HTTPS (TLS) connections,
access control on the admin panel (Supabase Auth authentication),
restricting data access to authorized WeUnite staff only,
regular reviews of permissions and security configuration.

s8.title: 8. Profiling and automated decision-making
s8.p1: Your data is not used for profiling or for automated decision-making that produces legal effects or similarly significant effects within the meaning of Article 22 GDPR. The email sequence is automatic, but sending it is not a decision that produces legal effects.

s9.title: 9. Changes to this Policy
s9.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy. We will inform you of any material change by publishing a new version on the Site together with its effective date. We recommend reviewing it regularly.
